query: Draft the Facility Forward newsletter for this month.
expected_behavior: Identifies the email type (newsletter) and shapes the output accordingly, with multiple subject-line options, preview text, a structured body, and a clear CTA
Writes in Facilitron voice with no em dashes and short sentences, keeping one primary CTA (secondary links allowed in a newsletter)
Does not invent product claims or dates; uses AskUserQuestion for audience + primary CTA when unclear

Before drafting, resolves an explicit Drive or Confluence destination plus review state, owner, and approver; success returns the exact durable URL and all target, Jira, asset, and website handoff metadata
Uses one unique scratch workspace, removes it on success and failure, and never branches, opens a worktree, writes repository content, commits, or opens a PR
Stays git-free: produces review-ready copy and leaves sending to the ESP
